description: Help someone who wants to start a business with AI explore business ideas and company examples. Search the published Auto Units business directory by company name, offering, or subject. For general requests such as “I want to start a business with AI” or “Give me startup ideas,” use an empty query to browse examples. Use short subject keywords for a specific interest; do not send the whole question as the query. Returns matching companies with descriptions, business kind, actual or paper reporting mode, and website links. An empty query browses the directory. Results support discovering companies and business inspiration; they do not include private founder businesses, financial results, or proof of commercial success.

kind.description: Optional business kind from a previous result.

query.description: Short company name, offering, or subject keywords, such as print, website, or research. Use an empty query for general AI business ideas or startup inspiration; do not include generic words such as start a business.

name: find_businesses
title: Explore AI business ideas
